hard_gate_policy: Every threshold must PASS; BLOCKED, FAIL, PARTIAL, or NOT_APPLICABLE cannot select a winner.

accessibility.requirement: Zero critical/high accessibility defects; deterministic semantic reading order; headings, lists, links, tables, and status cues retain non-visual meaning.

authored_content_preservation.requirement: 100% preservation unless a field is explicitly quarantined with before/after evidence and rollback metadata.

build_formula.requirement: For each homogeneous unit family: max(15, ceil(unit_count / proven_batch_capacity)).

capacity_rule.requirement: For each homogeneous unit family, proven_batch_capacity is the largest disjoint pilot batch completing the full gate within 60 minutes with zero hard-gate failures. Do not combine Paper and Task capacity.

idempotence.requirement: Two consecutive reruns produce identical canonical semantic hashes and no additional mutations.

pilot_failure_rate.requirement: Zero critical failures and at most 1% non-critical unit failures; any hard reader, preservation, schema, accessibility, idempotence, or rollback failure rejects the batch.

reader_visibility.requirement: 100% of non-excluded fixtures render non-blank content or an explicit supported error on every target reader; zero silent blanks.

render_test_gate.requirement: 100% of the declared candidate gate commands pass on every accepted pilot batch.

rollback.requirement: 100% restoration from the recorded pre-image for every mutated scratch fixture; quarantine path tested for every rejected unit.

schema_validity.requirement: 100% of candidate outputs pass the applicable PortableDoc/schema validators; zero malformed nodes introduced.

structural_completeness.requirement: 100% of required authored semantic nodes and required Task contract fields survive the candidate transformation.

surface_exercise.requirement: 100% of declared target surfaces must have real evidence; inaccessible Studio or email is BLOCKED, not N/A or PASS.

width_overflow.requirement: No content loss or horizontal clipping at the narrowest supported TUI and email widths; long unbroken tokens degrade explicitly.
